user.description: Pick the desk. The vendor app must be disconnected: the desk accepts one connection at a time.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name}? The vendor app must be disconnected: the desk accepts one connection at a time.

abort.no_devices_found: No TiMOTION desk found. Make sure it is powered and not connected to the vendor app.
abort.not_supported: This device is not a supported TiMOTION desk

init.description: Travel limits reported by the desk: {limits}.

data_description.min_height: Height for cover position 0 (closed). Empty: the desk's lower limit.
data_description.max_height: Height for cover position 100 (open). Empty: the desk's upper limit.
data_description.idle_timeout: Seconds to keep the connection after the last move, then release it so the vendor app can connect.
data_description.always_connected: Keep the connection open: live height updates (also when the handset moves the desk), and the desk does not go into standby after about an hour idle. The vendor app cannot connect meanwhile.

error.min_above_max: The lowest height must be below the highest height
